description: This PHP class extends Symfony Console Command to provide a CLI command for fixing PHP coding standards in the project using PHP-CS-Fixer. The class configures the command, handles the execution logic including cache reset and running the fixer, and outputs results or errors.

classes.name: PHPFixCodingStandardsCommand
classes.description: A Symfony Console Command class that runs PHP-CS-Fixer to automatically fix code style issues in the project directory.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up command description, help text, and options for the CLI command.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the fixing process, including optionally resetting the cache, invoking PHP-CS-Fixer, and handling output and errors.
